pages.title: Other Pauses
pages.text: If a job stalls without saying Not Printable, read the status line:$(li)$(l)No Power$(): feed it more RF$(li)$(l)No Filament$(): dock a fuller spool$(li)$(l)Output Full$(): clear the output$(li)$(l)Obstructed$(): clear the build area$(br2)Every pause is recoverable.
